purpose: Prove the trap: BAIK, DIEM, SUKSES, GAGAL all feed one unreading slot that prints four identical red verdicts on one tape.
visualConcept: FOUR INPUTS, ONE RED VERDICT TAPE

elements.purpose: Names the mechanism: the slot never reads the state
elements.text: SLOT INI NGGAK PERNAH BACA STATE LU.

storyboard.spokenMeaning: Whatever state you choose, the verdict is the same — the judge never reads the input.
storyboard.viewerTakeaway: Every possible version of you gets fed into one machine that only ever prints the same red verdict, so stop editing yourself to please it.

visualNarrative.action: Left column reveals headline plus one small caption; on the right only a bare feed slot and a short blank tape stub exist.
visualNarrative.meaning: The judge's mouth and its paper are installed before any input exists.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Headline block locked to left 8% margin; slot + 12%-long blank tape stub alone on the right axis.

visualNarrative.action: Input slip BAIK slides right into the slot; the tape draws down one segment and prints PENCITRAAN in red.
visualNarrative.meaning: First state enters, and the machine answers in its own fixed negative language.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Slip stops flush at the slot; first red row appears directly under the slot on the same vertical tape axis.

visualNarrative.action: Slip swaps to DIEM and feeds again; a second red row SOMBOG prints beneath the first, tape extending in one continuous strip.
visualNarrative.meaning: Different input, identical treatment — the verdict class never changes.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Two red rows stacked with equal 40px leading on one unbroken tape line; slot unchanged.

visualNarrative.action: Slip cycles SUKSES then GAGAGAL feeding twice more with tightening intervals; BERUNTUNG and DITERTAWAKAN print as rows three and four.
visualNarrative.meaning: Cumulative frustration: four parallel contradictions, one strip, no exception.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Four red rows in a single column, evenly spaced, all hanging from the same slot.

visualNarrative.action: Input slip empties and fades; the four red rows highlight top to bottom while headline and slot stay completely still.
visualNarrative.meaning: The machine never judged the person — it only ever printed.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Blank slot, four red verdict rows lit in sequence, headline untouched in the left column.

motionBeats.action: Headline reveals line by line with a short stagger, caption fading under it; tape stub draws in.
motionBeats.purpose: Sets the charge before the machine demonstrates it.

motionBeats.action: Input slip slides into the slot with soft ease-out; the tape extends and the first red row reveals.
motionBeats.purpose: Presents the current input and its immediate, unread answer.

motionBeats.action: Slip dissolve-swaps to DIEM, feeds again; second red row reveals below the first.
motionBeats.purpose: Repetition begins: input varies, response does not.

motionBeats.action: Final hold: rows highlight top to bottom while headline, slot and tape axis stay completely static.
motionBeats.purpose: Hands the viewer the indignation — same machine, four states, one verdict.

storyboard.compositionIntent: leftTextRightObject: headline + caption + feeding slip own the left half on an 8% margin; the right half is a single vertical axis where slot sits at ~28% height and the verdict tape hangs down to ~70%, stopping well clear of the bottom subtitle band. Slip travels only through empty space between the columns; nothing crosses axes, right edge stays dark vignette, ~65% negative space.
visualEvidence: Left text column and right tape axis never intersect; slip path runs through empty mid-space.
Tape grows as one unbroken line from a slot that never shifts position.
Four red verdict rows in one column with identical color, size and leading.
forbiddenInterpretations: Rubber-stamp seal press or descending hammer head (prior mechanism)
Any text row overlapping the headline, the slip path, or the bottom subtitle band
Struck-out / crossed-through words, rotating dial with needle, uniform grid with one lit cell
Conveyor belt, assembly line, factory machine housing or gears
Differently colored verdict rows or more than one accent color on the tape
A slot or tape that bends, adapts, or reacts to which slip is entering
Speech bubbles, human figures judging, or top-edge-clipped cards outside the safe frame
storyboard.noveltyIntent: A single vertical verdict tape fed by one unreading slot: four state slips enter horizontally, four identical-looking red rows print downward on one continuous strip. Verdict sameness is structural — one tape, one axis, one color — never a stamp, strike, dial or grid.

subtitle.role: spoken line — verbatim caption of the four parallel contradictions
